messages:
maya: Heads up — nightly evals spiked after the promptset v3.4 merge. 12 failing tests vs 2 yesterday, mostly summarization and long-form Q&A. CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/24567 :exclamation:

eval-bot: nightly-eval summary: model=redwood-v2-qa, promptset=v3.4, pass=88%, fail=12 tests, avg-rouge-drop=0.18, semantic-sim-drop=0.12

arjun: Did we change the model or only the promptset in today's deploy? :eyes:

maya: Only the promptset. PR #3421 merged ~07:15UTC by tom — 14 prompt edits (mostly edge-case clarifications). Link: https://git.internal/promptsets/3421

tom: Yep, I clarified a bunch of ambiguous instructions and split a few prompts into longer context variants. Didn't touch any model configs. I ran local evals but they looked fine on my branch.

sasha: Quick diff (excerpt) shows one replacement that could cause longer outputs — we removed the constraint line in several prompts: ```- Generate a 2-3 sentence summary. + Generate a summary.``` That expands generation length.

arjun: That could easily change rouge/len and downstream similarity. We should triage whether these are quality regressions or expected due to prompt behavior change. Can we get a minimal repro for the top 3 failing tests?

maya: Pasting two representative cases from the failing set:
Input: "Summarize the meeting notes focusing on actions."
Expected (v3.3 golden): "Action items: 1) Alice to follow up..., 2) Deploy planned for Thu."
Output (v3.4): "We discussed the timeline, blockers, and details around deployment. Alice will follow up on testing and the team plans to deploy on Thursday after QA passes. Also discussed potential rollbacks and contingency plans."

Input: "Answer: What is the recommended approach?"
Expected (v3.3): "Use incremental rollout and monitor metrics."
Output (v3.4): "We recommend an incremental rollout, monitor core metrics like latency, errors, and user engagement, set alerts for drift, and prepare a rollback plan if needed. Also consider canary testing and gradual traffic shifts."

maya: So outputs are longer/more verbose, which drops some of the automated metrics that rely on short golden texts.

liz: If the prompt author intentionally removed the length constraint, this is not necessarily a regression — it's a spec change. But per process any promptset version bump that changes test outcomes needs either rebaseline or an explicit approval. Rebaseline requires 2 ML lead approvals and a short rationale in the evals board.

sasha: Propose: revert to v3.3 for nightly evals to stop noise, then open a rebaseline PR that updates goldens for the prompts where the spec intentionally changed. For ambiguous ones we should keep them as regressions and investigate. Thoughts?

arjun: Agree. Revert in CI quickly, then rebaseline PR with diffs + examples. Also mark tests that are flaky due to length with a TODO ticket (EVAL-987) so we can decide whether to change metric or prompt. @liz @sasha please review the rebaseline when I open it.

tom: Fine with that. I can re-open a narrower PR that keeps length constraints where needed. My bad for not flagging the downstream eval impact. :man_facepalming:

eval-bot: Created issue EVAL-987: "Promptset v3.4 length-regressions" and PR 3450 in promptsets (revert-in-ci + rebaseline branch).

maya: I'll create the revert PR for CI config and link EVAL-987 + PR 3450. Tagging @arjun @liz for the two approvals required for a rebaseline merge. :white_check_mark:

sasha: I'll run a quick local quantized inference run to ensure this isn't a quantization-related artifact, but initial signal points to prompt wording.

liz: Thanks. Once PR 3450 has the diffs and proposed goldens, I'll review and ping for a second approval. We should also add a short note in the changelog: "v3.4 removed explicit length constraints for X prompts; rebaseline required for downstream tests."

arjun: Plan: revert CI -> triage failing list -> rebaseline PR with examples/diffs -> approvals -> merge. Keeping EVAL-987 as tracking.

maya: I'll do the revert now. Will post PR link in this thread.

tom: Thanks — will follow up with a smaller promptset patch after the revert.

maya: PR created: https://git.internal/promptsets/pull/3450 — includes revert CI change + rebaseline branch. Tagging reviewers. :eyes:
